claims.text: RSD injects grounded tool-feedback perturbations into environment scaling.

claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: To construct realistic environments with tool failures, we select 557 high-usage MCP server specifications from Smithery1, each defining an environment topic m ∈ M. Following Agent-World (Dong et al., 2026a), a research agent equipped with search, browser, coding, and operating-system tools builds and iteratively enriches a topic-grounded database. A coding agent then generates candidate tools and unit tests from each topic and its database. We retain only tools that compile, pass all tests, satisfy state-transition constraints, and support executable task verification.
